content:
GOAL: orient before writing the idea.
READ: workspace listing and repo layout (attempted glob of the ideation dir -> empty).
OBSERVED: ideation_4 workspace has no markdown; the meaningful code is elsewhere under GeneRec.
REASONING: I need to see the actual RQ-VAE quantizer and Stage3 interface so the proposal does not duplicate a repository mechanism and so the partition-guard shape is implementable.
OPEN: locate stage2 codebook update, stage3 SID token consumption, and the existing hyperbolic utilities.

GOAL: choose and fully specify one shape-(A) mechanism for this round.
READ: round-4 brief (three negative rounds, 107-pair contrast evidence, gauge note, gate 0.065 vs baseline 0.0679), prior rejected mechanism names.
OBSERVED: every prior loss moved the encoder input off the text geometry, merged/reshaped prefixes, or added a pinned level; none isolated leaf-token content at fixed prefix counts. Prior codebook-Frechet, per-level curvature, radial/entropy ranking and behaviour-weighted geodesic item moves are all taken.
REASONING: take shape (A) literally and make the guard provable: exchange level-3 labels pairwise within the same level-2 parent, which is a permutation and keeps every L1/L2/L3 count bit-identical; keep encoder and codebook frozen; put the coupling in one acceptance score s = DeltaCR_behaviour * exp(-max(0,Delta d_P)/delta) with fixed c=1 Poincare distance and delta = median|Delta d_P| measured on training candidates. Behaviour-off => DeltaCR:=1; geometry-off => Euclidean d and recomputed delta; both-on is the trained arm.
RESULT: final answer printed in the response. IDEA: BPLX-LEAF-EXCHANGE. Cost: zero extra training steps; one ~122780-pair CPU pass (<2 s, <0.5% of Stage-2 wall clock).
OPEN: single run decides; if test_recall@10 <= 0.065 with identical prefix counts and a raised contrast ratio, the 3-level leaf-content direction is closed.
